scope: All six source-dependent body-flow claims, all five citation keys, bibliographic metadata, exact nearby support, closest-prior-work coverage, method-source coverage, the active user-library selection, and internal exact-check attribution were audited.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage frozen extraction followed by claim-by-claim primary-source verification against official arXiv, Springer, Cornell, and SSRN records plus the frozen official source PDF; followed by BibTeX/source/aux key reconciliation and final log scans.
